# Entry-transaction fixtures

These four read-only PC v2.01 capture files are exact content copies from the
verified `Nioh3_Entry_Transaction_v201_20260913` Pro return package. They cover
the prior mode-upstream Sequence C transaction and the later materialization-
frontier Run C transaction for seed `86872488`.

The source archive SHA-256 is
`C82636402929934D80E5B1A92444CA2E86B469A23004A0CB1E807F8EB97A2B01`.
The package `MANIFEST.json` verifies the original payload identities. These
fixtures support offline reconciliation tests only; they are not a native mode
enum, physical-actor join, or product oracle.
